signature.one_line: Cream line-art explainer: face-pill cutout in evolving metaphor, blur-slide captions, 2x pink key.
unique_devices: Speaker becomes a small pink-bordered face pill (13-30 % W) linked into grey line art that morphs per sentence (one visual metaphor evolving through the whole piece)
Hook on desaturated, near-B&W footage with a hot-pink oval ring drawn around the face, then a hard switch to the cream canvas
Word-by-word captions that slide ~2 % W with a 3-frame horizontal motion blur into a pre-laid centred block in the top band; one key word per block on its own line at ~2x in hot pink
Concrete example as a full-screen contribution card on near-black: avatar rows with progress bars and counting percentages, the speaker's row in pink
signature.why_it_works: Villain plus cost in the first sentence, then the graphic state changes every ~0.5-1.5 s; a single saturated accent on a desaturated world steers the eye.

hook.first_frame: Desaturated medium shot of the speaker on a patterned grey wall with a hot-pink oval ring around the face; white caption building word by word at ~65-70 % height

structure.what: full thesis on desaturated footage with a pink face ring; key verb pops in big pink
hard switch to cream canvas; face pill becomes one link of a line-art chain; pink key words
motion-blur drop to dark; full-screen contribution card with progress bars
inset of the speaker over the metaphor drawing breaking apart
cost-of-coordination line on a node network; ends on a 2-word pink verdict and a horizontal pink chain

pacing.pace: measured slow (few shots) but felt fast: graphic state changes every ~0.5-1.5 s

captions.what: word-by-word centred block with a 2x pink key word line
captions.how: hook: block top 65 % H, lines at 66.8/71.2 %, key at 78.3 %; main: first line centre 15.1 %, key line 21.7-22.3 % (17.6 % when it opens the block), lines after key 24.5-28.9 %; lead Inter 500 77 px, key Inter 700 ~148-153 px; each word slides 2 % W with 3-frame motion blur on its spoken word; block exits blurring, fading and drifting up ~1 % H over ~6 frames

motion_graphics.what: evolving line-art metaphor with the face pill as one node
motion_graphics.how: grey line art on cream; face pill/rounded-rect cutout 13-30 % W with ~3 px pink border; drawing morphs every sentence (vertical -> broken -> network -> horizontal accent chain); link wobble, zoom-throughs
hot-pink oval outline ~1.5 % W stroke on desaturated footage with a faint white grid overlay

cards_lists.how: white rounded card x 9-91 %, y 41.5-82.5 % on near-black with a soft pink glow; folder icon + bold title + grey subtitle; 5 rows avatar + name + bar + right-aligned % counting up; the speaker's bar pink, others light grey; other rows fade out to leave one highlighted

silhouettes_cutouts.what: speaker face in a pill cutout
silhouettes_cutouts.how: small pill or rounded-rect cutout with a pink border, linked into the line art; inset clips are rounded rects with a ~3 px pink border

layout.what: cream canvas with top caption band
layout.how: captions in the upper ~10-30 % H, graphics and face pill in the middle/lower area

camera.how: no punch-ins on footage; motion comes from graphic zoom-throughs every ~1-2 s

case.lead: sentence case as spoken; a block that continues a sentence starts lowercase

captions_spec.punctuation: kept as spoken (commas, full stops, question marks)

grouping.sync: word-by-word: every word appears on its spoken word, at its final position in a pre-laid-out centred block (the block does not re-centre as it grows)
grouping.break: new block at each clause; old block blurs out, then the next block's first word arrives
grouping.inline_accent: occasionally a lead-size word is coloured pink inline instead of being enlarged

main_state.key_line_center_y_pct: 21.7-22.3 when the key is line 2; 17.6 when the key opens the block

lead.font_class: neo-grotesque sans, medium (round i-dot, double-storey a, single-storey g)
lead.color: #31302E on cream; #FFFFFF on footage / dark sections
lead.hook_note: white hook lines over a light area measured 2.97-3.59 % H - same tier, sizes estimated from the dark-frame calibration

key.size_note: fixed size, about 2.0x the lead (not fit-to-width): a 13-character word spans 77.6 % of W at the same size
key.selection_rule: the verb/noun that carries the claim; always on its own centred line

animation.word_entry: each word slides in from ~2 % W to the left of its final spot with horizontal motion blur: frame 1 smeared, frame 2 lightly blurred, frame 3 sharp in place (3 frames); no scale, no overshoot
animation.key_entry: same blur-slide as lead words (2-3 frames); no pop
animation.timing: on the spoken word: -5 to +6 frames vs word starts, typically 0-3 frames early
animation.exit: whole block blurs, fades to 0 and drifts up ~1 % H over ~6 frames; next block's first word lands ~1 frame after
animation.highlight: no moving highlight; the key colour is fixed per word

other_text_spec.text: no text: hot-pink #E23A78 oval/pill outline (~1.5 % W stroke, estimated) around the speaker's face on desaturated footage with a faint white diamond-grid overlay

no text: speaker face in a pink-bordered (#E23A78) pill / rounded-rect cutout 13-30 % of W, linked into grey #AFAEAD line art that morphs per sentence; inset clips are rounded rects with a ~3 px pink border

white rounded card x 9-91 %, y 41.5-82.5 % with a soft pink outer glow; pink folder icon + 'Card title' (bold #3A3A3A, ~2.3 % H) + grey subtitle; 5 rows: avatar circle, 'Name' (semibold), progress bar (pink #E33A78 for the speaker's row, light grey for others), right-aligned % that counts up; other rows fade out to leave one highlighted

style.look_intent: near-B&W desaturated speaker, warm cream canvas, high-contrast dark text, grey line art, a single hot-pink accent

sound.music: voice only (no bed detected; gaps are true silence)
sfx: no hits on the hard cuts (measured cut_hit_share 0.0)
soft whoosh on motion-blur drops and zoom-throughs (inferred)

sound.method: heuristic (onset-envelope beat periodicity + level in speech gaps); not a classifier

use_when: A management, leadership or workplace argument that can be expressed with one visual metaphor
Plain or unremarkable speaker footage that can be desaturated and shrunk to a cutout
A short, dense thesis with one concrete example that can be shown as a simple UI card
The brand has one strong accent colour to carry the whole piece
avoid_when: The speaker's face and expression are the main draw (they are tiny for most of the runtime)
No design time for custom line art per sentence
brand_prompt:
Use /video-pipeline with /video-captions on videos/<project>. Apply style blueprint B32 (video-reference-match/references/blueprints/B32.json) to this brand.
Canvas 1080x1920, 30 fps. Speaker footage desaturated; most of the piece on a light canvas with line art.

BRAND TOKENS (use the brand's colour/font for each role; keep the contrast relationship: {{ACCENT}} is the ONLY saturated colour and must stay >= 3:1 on {{SURFACE}} and on the desaturated footage; {{TEXT}} >= 7:1 on {{SURFACE}})
- {{TEXT}}: default #31302E on cream (white #FFFFFF on footage / dark sections)
- {{ACCENT}}: default #E23A78 (key words, face ring, pill borders, highlighted bar)
- {{ACCENT_2}}: default #AFAEAD (line art)
- {{SURFACE}}: default #FBF8F7 (cream canvas)
- {{CARD_BG}}: default #121212 (dark section behind the UI card)
- {{FONT_DISPLAY}}: default Inter 700 (key words)
- {{FONT_BODY}}: default Inter 500 (lead words)
- {{HANDLE}}: not on screen
- {{LOGO}}: none

CAPTIONS
1. Latin, as spoken, punctuation kept; sentence case (continuation blocks start lowercase); key words lowercase; no emoji.
2. Blocks of 2-8 words (~5), up to 4 lines, laid out centred in advance (does not re-centre while growing); 0-1 key word per block on its own line.
3. Lead: {{FONT_BODY}} at 77 px, tracking -0.02em, {{TEXT}}; key: {{FONT_DISPLAY}} at ~148-153 px (~2x lead, fixed size), tracking -0.03em, {{ACCENT}}. No stroke, shadow or box.
4. Hook state (first ~11 %, over footage): block top 65 % H, lines at 66.8 % / 71.2 %, key at 78.3 %, pitch 4.4 % H. Main state (canvas): first line centre 15.1 % H, key line 21.7-22.3 % (17.6 % when it opens the block), lines after key 24.5-28.9 %, lead pitch 4.9 % H, lead-to-key baseline pitch 8.3 % H; max width 78 % W, margins >= 11 % W.
5. Each word appears on its spoken word (0-3 frames early), sliding ~2 % W from the left with a 3-frame horizontal motion blur (smeared, light blur, sharp); no scale. Block exit: blur + fade + drift up ~1 % H over ~6 frames; the next block's first word lands ~1 frame later.

GRAPHICS AND EDIT DEVICES
6. Hook: desaturated footage, {{ACCENT}} oval ring (~1.5 % W stroke) around the face, faint white grid overlay; hard switch to {{SURFACE}} at ~11 %.
7. Speaker as a face pill / rounded-rect cutout 13-30 % W with a ~3 px {{ACCENT}} border, linked into one {{ACCENT_2}} line-art metaphor that changes state every sentence (break, branch, network, final {{ACCENT}} version). Change the graphic state every ~0.5-1.5 s.
8. Example beat (~14 % of runtime): motion-blur drop to {{CARD_BG}}; white rounded card x 9-91 %, y 41.5-82.5 % with a soft {{ACCENT}} glow; icon + 'Card title' + grey subtitle; 5 rows avatar + 'Name' + bar + counting %; the hero row's bar in {{ACCENT}}, others light grey; others fade out.
9. Transitions: graphic zoom-throughs and vertical motion-blur drops (~6-8 frames); one hard footage->canvas switch.
10. No lower-thirds, logos or emoji.

GRADE: Grade from the user's footage (video-style / grade.py); target look: near-B&W desaturated speaker, warm cream canvas, high-contrast text, one saturated accent.
SOUND: voice only, dense delivery (do not speed up artificially), -14 LUFS; soft whooshes on blur drops.

VERIFY
a) Render the key word "lose" at 148 px on line 2 of a block on {{SURFACE}} and measure:
   python video-reference-match/scripts/caption_probe.py <test_render> --out <dir> --at <t> --box 0.06,0.18,0.94,0.26 --ink "{{ACCENT}}:60"   (default ink #E23A78)
   Required: 5.62 % ±0.5 of H, 24.2 % ±2 of W. "no point" at 153 px: 7.5 % H, 49.2 % W (--box 0.06,0.10,0.94,0.215).
b) Lead: "everybody else is" at 77 px white over {{CARD_BG}}: --box 0.06,0.12,0.94,0.175 --ink "#FFFFFF:50" -> 3.75 % ±0.5 H, 51.9 % ±2 W.
c) Expected ink for any other word: video-reference-match/scripts/fit_font.py --font "{{FONT_BODY}}" --word <word> --tracking -0.02.
